method: Extract 144 individual PU-FMT statements directly from latest live Drive v1.13, compare selected obligations to shared template source, classify ALL requirements without falsely certifying production and full-page render QA.

per_rule.title: Authority
per_rule.approved_rule: Official PU/FST guideline is the first formatting authority; original PU/FST MSc DOCX is second when the guideline is silent or visually specific; explicit user-approved conflict resolutions govern documented official-source conflicts; implementation candidates are technical evidence only.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Paper
per_rule.approved_rule: Use white A4 paper, 21 cm x 29.7 cm, single-sided.
per_rule.evidence_note: geometry A4 single sided

per_rule.title: Margins
per_rule.approved_rule: Use left 3.0 cm; right 2.5 cm; top 2.5 cm; bottom 2.5 cm.
per_rule.evidence_note: geometry margin values

per_rule.title: Body font
per_rule.approved_rule: Use exact Times New Roman, 12 pt, regular, black for normal text. Production builds must verify that a Times New Roman face is embedded in the PDF.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Font fallback
per_rule.approved_rule: A compatibility fallback may be enabled only as an explicitly logged non-production mode. It must never silently replace Times New Roman in a submission build.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Line spacing
per_rule.approved_rule: Use 1.5 line spacing for normal thesis prose.
per_rule.evidence_note: onehalfspacing

per_rule.title: Hyphenation
per_rule.approved_rule: Do not break words across lines by hyphenation.
per_rule.evidence_note: hyphenpenalty and exhyphenpenalty

per_rule.title: Paragraphs
per_rule.approved_rule: Use zero global first-line indentation and zero global paragraph-after spacing. Do not invent a thesis-wide indent not supported by PU sources.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Abstract indent
per_rule.approved_rule: Apply an approximately four-space first-line indent specifically to abstract paragraphs, reflecting the PU abstract instruction.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Chapter opening
per_rule.approved_rule: Each numbered chapter starts on a new page. Render CHAPTER <N> and the chapter title as a compact left-aligned 12 pt bold hierarchy; chapter title is uppercase.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Sections
per_rule.approved_rule: Use left-aligned numbered section and subsection headings at 12 pt Times New Roman, bold, with controlled spacing and no decorative color.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Front matter order
per_rule.approved_rule: Order: Cover; Title; optional Dedication; Declaration; Recommendation; Certificate; Acknowledgements; Abbreviations/Acronyms; Units and Conversions; Abstract; Table of contents; List of tables; List of figures; conditional List of plates/pictures; conditional List of appendices; then main text.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Mandatory lists
per_rule.approved_rule: Abbreviations/Acronyms and Units and Conversions are included in the approved preliminary sequence. Dedication remains optional; plates/pictures and appendices lists appear only when the corresponding item type exists.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Preliminary pagination
per_rule.approved_rule: Cover is unnumbered and not counted in Roman preliminaries. Title page is Roman i but the numeral is hidden. Optional Dedication is ii. Declaration is iii if Dedication exists, otherwise ii. Roman numbering continues through the remaining preliminaries.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Main pagination
per_rule.approved_rule: Start Arabic numbering at Chapter 1, page 1.
per_rule.evidence_note: Arabic main-body numbering macro

per_rule.title: Cover typography
per_rule.approved_rule: Use PU sample hierarchy: 16 pt degree line; 20 pt bold thesis title; 1.6 x 1.6 inch university logo area; principal student/institution/date lines 16 pt with bold where prescribed by the sample; explicit controlled vertical spacing.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Title page typography
per_rule.approved_rule: Use PU sample hierarchy: 16 pt degree line; 20 pt bold thesis title; 16 pt supervision/submission/student/institution/date blocks as prescribed; controlled LaTeX spacing rather than manual blank paragraphs.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Narrative front headings
per_rule.approved_rule: Declaration, Recommendation, Certificate, Acknowledgements and Abstract use centered bold 16 pt headings.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: List front headings
per_rule.approved_rule: Table of contents, List of tables, List of figures, List of plates/pictures, List of appendices, Abbreviations/Acronyms and Units and Conversions use centered bold 14 pt headings.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Dedication
per_rule.approved_rule: Dedication is optional, brief, centered on the page, has no heading, and is not listed in the Table of contents.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Abstract content format
per_rule.approved_rule: Abstract uses 12 pt Times New Roman, justified, 1.5 spacing, no internal headings, citations, displayed equations, figures, tables or other illustrative material.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Abstract length
per_rule.approved_rule: Target 300-350 words and one-page containment. Never shrink font or violate margins to force one page; a second page is permitted only when a compliant 300-350-word abstract genuinely cannot fit.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Keywords
per_rule.approved_rule: Place Keywords below the abstract after one blank line; 3-7 keywords.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: TOC/LOT/LOF
per_rule.approved_rule: Generate automatically. Use 14 pt bold centered headings; 12 pt single-spaced entries; dot leaders; right-aligned page numbers; correct chapter/section/subsection and figure/table numbering.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: List pagination
per_rule.approved_rule: Allow genuine continuation pages rather than shrinking list text below the approved size. Use pagination safeguards to avoid a continuation page containing only one or very few entries when a compliant reflow can solve it.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Abbreviations
per_rule.approved_rule: Present abbreviations/acronyms alphabetically with 12 pt single-spaced entries and a fixed approximately 2.5 cm abbreviation field before the expansion; do not insert colon/semicolon between abbreviation and meaning.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Units
per_rule.approved_rule: Present Units and Conversions as a dedicated 12 pt single-spaced list page using a stable two-column layout.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table numbering
per_rule.approved_rule: Number tables by chapter (e.g., Table 3.4 means the fourth table of Chapter 3).
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table caption
per_rule.approved_rule: Place table caption above the table and left-align it. Use Table <chapter.number>. <caption> as the generalized visible pattern.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table rules
per_rule.approved_rule: Normal technical/data tables use an open layout with no routine vertical grid lines and selective horizontal rules. Booktabs-style implementation is preferred where it reproduces the PU sample; ordinary horizontal rules remain allowed for special tables that require them.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table font size
per_rule.approved_rule: Use 12 pt Times New Roman by default. Reduce only when genuinely necessary, targeting a 10 pt minimum. Below 10 pt requires an explicit documented exception; otherwise split, restructure or rotate the table.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table continuation
per_rule.approved_rule: Multipage tables repeat the header and use a clear continuation mechanism; do not shrink excessively merely to keep a table on one page.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table width
per_rule.approved_rule: Tables must remain within the text block. Prefer wrapping, flexible columns, landscape pages or splitting before any extreme scaling.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Table source
per_rule.approved_rule: When a table is reproduced/adapted from another source, place the source with the caption inside square brackets when applicable.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Figure numbering
per_rule.approved_rule: Number figures by chapter and cite them as Fig. <chapter.number>.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Figure placement
per_rule.approved_rule: Center the figure/image within the text block and preserve aspect ratio. Constrain width/height to avoid clipping.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Figure caption
per_rule.approved_rule: Place the figure caption below the figure and center the caption, following the user-approved PU Appendix 17 visual convention.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Figure source
per_rule.approved_rule: When a figure is reproduced/adapted from another source, include the source with the caption inside square brackets when applicable.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Figure text size
per_rule.approved_rule: Use 12 pt Times New Roman where figure text is author-controlled; target a 10 pt minimum for necessary compactness. Below 10 pt requires explicit exception and readability QA.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Float policy
per_rule.approved_rule: Use normal floating placement as the default; force exact placement only when necessary for meaning/layout. Floats must never create clipping or unacceptable near-empty pages.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Equations
per_rule.approved_rule: Typeset equations with a mathematical equation environment/editor. Number equations sequentially and cite as Eq. (n).
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Cross references
per_rule.approved_rule: Use source-level labels/references for equations, figures, tables, chapters, sections and appendices; do not hard-code reference numbers in prose.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Citation style
per_rule.approved_rule: Support IEEE, Harvard and APA 7th edition. Every thesis must explicitly choose one in project configuration; there is no hidden default.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Reference heading
per_rule.approved_rule: Use the thesis-wide heading REFERENCES, regardless of IEEE, Harvard or APA 7th edition choice.
per_rule.evidence_note: REFERENCES heading macros

per_rule.title: Citation consistency
per_rule.approved_rule: Once IEEE, Harvard or APA 7th edition is selected, use it consistently throughout the entire thesis.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Appendix purpose
per_rule.approved_rule: Appendices are supplementary end matter used for supporting text, data sheets, graphs, code, pictures or other detailed material that should not interrupt the main body.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Appendix start
per_rule.approved_rule: Start each appendix on a new page; use a centered bold 14 pt Appendix <N>: <TITLE> heading as the approved deterministic implementation.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Appendix list
per_rule.approved_rule: Generate a List of appendices only when appendices exist; appendix entries use normal sequence and page numbers.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Headers/footers
per_rule.approved_rule: Do not introduce running headers. Use plain page-number footers; cover/title hide the printed number as required by the pagination rules.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Widow/orphan
per_rule.approved_rule: Use strong widow/orphan controls and heading-keep safeguards, but do not distort page geometry or font size to satisfy them.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Near-empty pages
per_rule.approved_rule: Avoid nearly-empty continuation pages when compliant source-level reflow can solve them; never solve them by unapproved font shrinking.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Overflow
per_rule.approved_rule: No text, table, figure or caption may enter the margins or clip. Treat any overfull box or visible clipping as a QA failure.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Hyperlinks
per_rule.approved_rule: Preserve internal cross-reference and citation hyperlink functionality while keeping submission-visible link styling black/non-decorative.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Build authority
per_rule.approved_rule: LaTeX source is the authoritative editable layout source for this generalized template. Manual PDF patching is not an authoritative workflow.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Compile engine
per_rule.approved_rule: Use XeLaTeX for production so exact Times New Roman can be requested and verified.
per_rule.evidence_note: XeTeX engine guard

per_rule.title: Compile sequence
per_rule.approved_rule: Controlled build sequence: XeLaTeX -> Biber -> XeLaTeX -> XeLaTeX, repeated further if references/lists remain unsettled.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Precompile gates
per_rule.approved_rule: Before release compile: validate project configuration, citation-style selection, required assets, absence of unresolved placeholders/workflow paths and compliance with the approved format rules.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: PDF verification
per_rule.approved_rule: After compile: validate A4 page size, margins, embedded font identity, page numbering, abstract/keywords, generated lists, unresolved references, and PDF integrity.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Render QA
per_rule.approved_rule: A successful compiler exit is insufficient. Render the complete final PDF and visually inspect every page for release; during iterative editing inspect all changed pages plus regression pages.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Regression QA
per_rule.approved_rule: For formatting-only changes, compare renders against the previous approved milestone and verify that only intended visual regions/pages changed.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Traceability
per_rule.approved_rule: Every approved formatting release preserves source, rules, build instructions, QA checklist, source reconciliation and changelog.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Content isolation
per_rule.approved_rule: The generalized template/control contains placeholders only and must never import names, titles, research data, results, figures, bibliography entries, conclusions or other project-specific thesis content.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Academic-facing output
per_rule.approved_rule: Student-facing defense/submission PDFs must contain academic thesis language only and must not expose internal workflow, AI, data-management, source-lock, checkpoint or QA-process narration.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Internal-control separation
per_rule.approved_rule: Source provenance, lineage, workflow state, unresolved-decision tracking and QA warnings remain in internal control artifacts or an explicitly labeled internal-control build.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Canonical preliminary wording
per_rule.approved_rule: Declaration, Recommendation and Certificate use the approved PU/FST template wording. Missing administrative/signature fields remain blank or source-level TBD; explanatory replacement prose is prohibited in the student-facing thesis.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Midterm incompleteness
per_rule.approved_rule: Scientifically incomplete methods/results may be retained in a midterm thesis only with neutral academic wording that accurately states their current status and does not imply completion.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Shared evidence base
per_rule.approved_rule: Internal-control and student-facing outputs must be generated from the same governed research source/evidence base so that scientific claims/results cannot silently diverge.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Versioned releases

per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Missing-field behavior

per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Audit visual identity
per_rule.approved_rule: The INTERNAL AUDIT PDF must carry persistent audit banner/watermark/footer treatment and an unmistakable internal filename so it cannot be confused with a thesis deliverable.
per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: Audit colors

per_rule.title: Generic acknowledgements

per_rule.title: Font build dependency

per_rule.evidence_note: Source rule audited; real implementation and/or evidence still requires work

per_rule.title: APA support

per_rule.title: Reference-label separation
